planned_outcome: Deep RCA: why does no physics model fit below the ~6 deg C floor across 17 missions, given that real bake time is 22-25 minutes (much shorter than the 60+ min we may have implicitly modelled). Find the actual root cause via parallel investigation: (a) bake-time-to-physics audit (does the 22-25 min target imply specific alpha/Bi we're missing?), (b) M9-Stefan deep diagnostic (the best result we have — characterise its residual shape, not just RMSE), (c) data-vs-model trace on one fixture (overlay model prediction against observed sensors timestep-by-timestep and visually identify where it diverges).
actual_outcome: RCA identified single primary root cause: alpha_dough pinned 5-7x too low across M9/M11/M12/M14/M15. Recommend M20 HMS Resolute single-fixture diagnostic on BA3C_0946 with alpha_dough free over 5e-7..1e-5 and delta_T_smear free over 3..10 C. If main-bake RMSE drops below 4 C verdict GO; otherwise final pivot to Method 4 metadata capture.
